prompt: A small geostationary platform. The implied delta-v is far beyond its class. Name the event, and the first action the governing procedure requires.
plot_description: Sub-satellite longitude against time. A single large step in drift rate appears between two fits, implying a burn an order of magnitude larger than the platform class is capable of.
accepted_first_actions: check whether the track is correctly associated
expert_cue: A figure the platform cannot produce is evidence about the data, not about the platform. The usual cause is a track associated to the wrong object.
